# Surface mesh of Auckland's Maunga Whau volcano

Surface mesh corresponding to the altitude on a 10m by 10m grid of
Auckland's Maunga Whau volcano.

## Usage

``` r
data(volcanom)
```

## Format

### `volcanom`

A
[rgl::mesh3d](https://dmurdoch.github.io/rgl/dev/reference/mesh3d.html)-class
object with 5307 vertices and 10320 triangles.

## Source

[datasets::volcano](https://rdrr.io/r/datasets/volcano.html) and example
taken from
[rgl::surface3d](https://dmurdoch.github.io/rgl/dev/reference/surface3d.html).

## Examples

``` r
library(rgl)
open3d() # Alternatively, use `new3d()` to clear the current device or open a new one
aspect3d(1, 1, 3)  # Exaggerate the relief
shade3d(volcanom, col = "lightgreen")
3D plot
```
